answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by forge identity through a slow sequential willow of work instead of instant registration. Each newcomer plants a willow sapling by completing unpredictable tasks witnessed by random peers outside its cluster. A failed audit burns the stake and drops the account to nadir zero weight requiring the entire climb to repeat. An honest agent grows one willow; a swarm of clones must tend a forest paying the full cost for every fake key. Sybil floods become an unaffordable nursery.
